lines.t: The silence echoes deep inside my chest
Flickers fade where I once found rest
I chase the dawn through an empty sky
Till I heard your voice reply
In the stillness you whisper my name
A spark through the dark, unchained by shame
I'll lose you, I'll break through the shadow
Lift me where the lost wind blows
You're like us through my sorrow
Now my weary spirit knows
Every tear was leading home
The storm surrounds but you still remain
Turning fear to holy flame
The chains I wore fall to the ground
Your mercy sings a healing sound
Every scar you turn to gold
Every story grace foretold
You breathe life where ashes lay
And darkness fades away
Yahushua, break through the shadow
Raise my heart where the rivers flow
Your love conquers the sorrow
Every wound you overflow
Now I'm finally home
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh.
Thank you.
